text: CHANGE remove dead fallbacks from the PouchDB era: the `'UNKNOWN'` fallback for `previousDocumentData` on `UPDATE` change events, the `getDocumentDataOfRxChangeEvent()` function, the no-op `postMigrateDocument` hook of the attachments plugin, the `RxCollection.awaitPersistence()` type and unused CouchDB types. In dev-mode, an RxStorage that emits an `UPDATE` event without `previousDocumentData` now throws the error `CE1`
